classification: independent source-law diagnostic; not a BNG3 result and not an SSTS verdict

source_case.model: X -> 2X at rate 1*X; X -> 0 at rate 1.1*X; X(0)=100

source_law.conditional_transition: Binomial surviving ancestral lineages plus negative-binomial geometric descendants
source_law.fourth_moment: derived from the one-lineage zero-inflated geometric PGF; summed cumulants for 100 initial lineages

calibration.output_times: integer t=1..50; paths are reused across times

interpretation: The exact source-law simulation shows the fixed normal-theory SD criterion can exceed its 1-3 violation guidance even with a correct source sampler. It supports recalibrating a separate diagnostic; it does not establish correctness of the archived BNG3 sample or final-main behavior.
